# polylane_aws_connection (Resource)

Activates a Polylane connection using AWS resources managed by the customer. Polylane validates and reads these resources but does not manage their AWS lifecycle.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "polylane_aws_connection" "current" {
  workspace_id           = polylane_aws_connection_request.current.workspace_id
  request_id             = polylane_aws_connection_request.current.id
  region                 = polylane_aws_connection_request.current.region
  role_arn               = aws_iam_role.polylane.arn
  bucket_name            = aws_s3_bucket.cloudtrail.id
  topic_arn              = aws_sns_topic.cloudtrail.arn
  topic_subscription_arn = aws_sns_topic_subscription.polylane.arn
  cloudtrail_name        = aws_cloudtrail.polylane.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket_name` (String) Name of the customer-managed S3 bucket receiving CloudTrail objects.
- `cloudtrail_name` (String) Name of the customer-managed CloudTrail trail.
- `region` (String) AWS handshake region returned by polylane_aws_connection_request.
- `request_id` (String) ID returned by polylane_aws_connection_request.
- `role_arn` (String) ARN of the customer-managed IAM role Polylane may assume.
- `topic_arn` (String) ARN of the customer-managed SNS topic receiving CloudTrail notifications.
- `topic_subscription_arn` (String) ARN of the customer-managed, confirmed SNS HTTPS subscription that delivers notifications to Polylane.
- `workspace_id` (String) ID of the Polylane workspace that owns the connection.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) Twelve-digit AWS account ID registered with Polylane.
- `id` (String) Unique Polylane cloud-account ID.
- `regions` (Set of String) AWS regions Polylane may read and synchronize.
- `status` (String) Polylane registration status. Registered means the connection is durable; initial synchronization may continue asynchronously.
